name: Moclobemide
metabolism: Oxidation, mainly of the morpholine portion, precedes renal elimination of metabolites. CYP2C19 phenotype influences exposure; little drug is excreted unchanged.
summary: Moclobemide is a reversible, selective monoamine oxidase A inhibitor used primarily to treat depression and social anxiety. Its interactions with serotonergic and sympathomimetic medicines can be clinically important.
